audience: Developers, builders and hiring managers on LinkedIn.
style_reference: High-retention AI-tools reels, LANDSCAPE 16:9 1920x1080 @ 60 fps (look 'land', default). Topic on screen by 2 s. 9:16 'dazz' look still available via storyboard look:'dazz'.
avoid: Jailbreak / piracy / exploit repos and anything that breaks ToS

voice.voice_name: Liam - Energetic, Social Media Creator (premade, American)
voice.rule: FIXED NARRATOR for every reel (daily, promo, documentary). Never swap voices (owner's rule, 2026-10-22).
voice.plan: Creator tier, ~131k characters/month - a 90-word script is ~550 characters

voice_gmi.post: tighten_voice max_gap 0.12, tempo 1.12 (re-check: MiniMax pacing differs from Liam)
voice_gmi.rule: Used only when VOICE_PROVIDER/MEDIA_PROVIDER=gmi. Switching provider changes the channel narrator: the owner picks the voice_id once (voice_samples, or a MiniMax voice clone of the owner's own voice), then it stays fixed like Liam.

music_gmi.note: Used when MUSIC_PROVIDER/MEDIA_PROVIDER=gmi. Instrumental via structure-tag lyrics; no length control, the drop is detected in the track.

clips_gmi.note: generate_clip default (4-15 s, 480p/720p). Alternatives: veo-3.1-generate-001, veo-3.1-fast-generate-001, kling-v3-text-to-video, wan2.7-t2v (pass their fields in payload).

layout.notes: Instagram/YouTube UI covers ~top 220 px, bottom 20% (y>1536) and a right-edge column (x>960) of buttons. Handle sits at the top (y 300), captions centred at x 520 / y 1180 and max 800 px wide, so they never meet.

music_prompt: Modern dark trap / phonk-lite instrumental for a tech reel, punchy 808s, crisp hats, tense synth, no vocals, steady energy, 140 bpm
cta_default: No comment-word CTA on LinkedIn: end on where the code or link is (the link goes in the first comment).

voice_v3.endpoint: /v1/text-to-speech/{voice_id}/with-timestamps (returns character alignment; [tags] are stripped from captions)
voice_v3.voice_name: Liam - Energetic, Social Media Creator (premade, American)
voice_v3.post: tighten_voice max_gap 0.12, tempo 1.12 (v3 has no speed setting; Liam reads ~2.9 words/s raw -> ~3.2 after)
voice_v3.chosen: 2026-10-20 from a 4-voice v3 test of the hook line (jobs/20261020-ai-job-search-dazz/voice/samples/). Liam: widest pitch range (17.5 semitones p10-p90), fastest (3.6 w/s), clear. Charlie (Australian) close second; Chris clearest but flat (4 st); Viraj (Indian English, professional voice) slowest and 'hired' came out unclear.
voice_v3.tags: use 1-3 per script, e.g. [excited] on the hook, [curious] before the results question; keep delivery casual, not dramatic
voice_v3.rule: FIXED. Do not use alternates; same narrator on every reel.

dazz.description: notmy.bug / ai.byprince-style: disconnect hook (abstract clips + typed serif hook) -> cream paper plate + 'welcome to day N' ransom strips -> framed 16:9 screen recording with camera moves, cursor, highlight boxes -> paper CTA with stickers. 60 fps.

day_counter.rule: storyboard 'day' + script 'welcome to day N' use next; mark_published bumps it by one

fonts.strips: DM Serif Display / Abril Fatface / Special Elite (OFL/Apache)

audio.music: ElevenLabs Music instrumental, gain ~0.34, duck 4 dB
audio.also_export: final_nomusic.mp4 (voice + SFX) for adding a trending in-app track

land.description: 16:9 1920x1080 @ 60 fps. Project-first hook (floating UI window + H1 + drafting lines, optional prop cutout with speech bubble, abstract 0.3-0.5 s flashes) -> editorial title card -> floating dark browser window demo with slow push, cursor, pop-bounce clicks, callouts, sentence captions -> CTA -> dark logo card.
land.motion: Expo-out cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), 450 ms per element, 80 ms stagger
land.captions: sentence-level, lower-middle (y ~868), Inter SemiBold 46 on a dark pill
land.cta: LinkedIn: no comment keyword; the CTA scene names where the code/link is

audio.music: ElevenLabs Music auto (drop on the hook->body cut)
